text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Notice Under Section 7 My Reference No.: Ambako/3/1/A/143-V Land Ministry Reference No: 4-3/7/2013/HW/577 I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7, of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/ Servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or Servitude to be acquire:- Lot No. 01 of Kudaoya Watta below name land in total extent about 0.0145 Hectare, shown in Preliminary Plan No. Nu. 3014 and dated 30.07.2015, prepared by the Surveyor Genaral, situated in the village of Kudaoya and Minor Division of Ambagamuwa Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ambagamuwa, in the District of Nuwara Eliya. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Kudaoya Watta; Names and Addresses of the Claimant: P. K. C. S. Kumara, No. 06,, Nuwaraeliya Road, Kudaoya, Hatton; Extent: 0.0145 Hectares. Boundaries: North: Road ( Road Development Authority) and Lot No. 92 of P.P.NU. 2786; East: Road ( Road Development

Authority), Lot No. 93 of P.P.Nu. 2786; South: Road (Road Development Authority), Lot No. 93 of P.P.Nu. 2785 and Part of Hi. Pi. 45509; West: Part of Hi. Pi. 45509 and Road. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on witch a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Ambagamuwa of the 13th day of July, 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 29th Day of June, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/ servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. R. T. P. SUMANASEKARA, Divisional Secretary, Ambagamuwa Koralaya, Ginigathhena.
